about.title: About Me
about.text: Master's Degree in Cyber Security from the University of Milan and Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science from the University of Parma. Currently serving as IT Security Engineer within the PMO & Technology Security function at Zefiro NET, managing strategic projects and compliance (NIS2, ISO 27001, GDPR). I combine a deep passion for cybersecurity with experience in IT Project Management and university teaching.

education.title: Education
education.master_desc: Specialization in cryptography, network security, and risk management.
education.bachelor_desc: Fundamentals of computer science, algorithms, and software development.

experience.title: Work Experience
experience.zefiro_desc: PMO & Technology Security function. Management and supervision of IT and CyberSecurity projects, Risk Analysis, Vulnerability Assessment, GDPR, ISO 27001, Golden Power.
experience.prof_desc: Lecturer for a 3-credit course at the Department of Mathematical, Physical, and Computer Sciences.
experience.amabile_desc: Digital infrastructure re-platforming, IT vendor management for software integration, IT team management, Social Media and online Sales.
experience.idea_desc: Web/app development with CMS Wordpress, Shopify, Magento, Prestashop, creative team coordination, and SEO/Ads optimization.

acn.title: Monitor ACN NIS2
acn.subtitle: Web Portal • Telegram Channel • iOS App • GitHub Actions
acn.desc: Integrated ecosystem for continuous monitoring of updates from the Italian National Cybersecurity Agency (ACN) regarding the NIS2 Directive and General Acts. Features an interactive web portal, real-time Telegram alerts, and a native iOS app available on the App Store.

cybernews.title: CyberNews
cybernews.desc: Platform and native iOS application in Swift to aggregate and monitor real-time cyber threats, zero-day vulnerabilities, ransomware campaigns, and regulatory frameworks (NIS2, Golden Power, DORA, ISO 27001) with iOS widgets and push alerts.

gdpr_guard.title: GDPR Guard
gdpr_guard.desc: Local-first, GDPR-compliant automated PII anonymizer for detecting, masking, and redacting sensitive data in structured files and logs. Dual-engine (Regex + NLP via Microsoft Presidio & spaCy) with Streamlit Web UI and CLI.

password_cracking.title: Password Cracking Rig
password_cracking.desc: Cybersecurity benchmarking lab analyzing password entropy vs. length with Hashcat, featuring a Python Shannon entropy calculator and an interactive dark-mode awareness presentation dashboard.

smc.title: SMC in Genomics
smc.desc: Secure computation of Edit Distance on genomic data using Secure Multiparty Computation (SMC). Focus on biological data privacy and computational performance optimization in C++.

cti.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence
cti.desc: Proactive defense architecture using distributed Honeypots and IBM QRadar SIEM, integrated with MISP threat intelligence feeds for automated correlation and rapid response to IoCs.

viewer.title: VieweR (Mobile VR)
viewer.desc: Mobile Virtual Reality application for Android developed with Unity3D, C#, and Google Cardboard SDK for interactive 360° virtual tours and immersive exploration.
